audit.frequency_policy: Exact 500-bin teaching grid: f_j = 32.3 + 0.0015287*j MHz, j=0..499

resampling.method: Piecewise linear interpolation in frequency, applied independently to phase and baseline in float64; basesub = phase - baseline
resampling.endpoint_policy: Clamp only endpoint roundoff within four floating-point spacings; no physical extrapolation
resampling.support_policy: Use the confirmed target window; source frequencies beyond its upper endpoint are outside the working example
resampling.noise_policy: Interpolation changes noise correlation and resolution; no independent-bin noise or measured covariance claim
resampling.model_policy: Evaluate the conditional model on source frequencies and apply the same interpolation before fitting all 500 target bins

audit.subtraction_check: resampled phase - resampled baseline equals basesub for every bin
audit.selection: Five records evenly spaced in file order: 1, 126, 251, 376, 501; selected before fitting, not by fit quality
audit.units: Frequencies in MHz; phase, baseline and basesub retain recorded units; no independently supplied voltage conversion

config.description: Joint fit of the full raw UVA-ND3 phase sweeps and their baseline with the ND3 spin-1 susceptibility and physical Q-meter circuit, on the exact 500-bin grid.
config.readout: a Re[u exp(i phi(f))] + b Im[u exp(i phi(f))] + d, profiled jointly with lineshape and electronics on raw phase
config.background_convention: Baseline = same fitted full circuit/readout with chi=0; signal = full fit minus baseline. No stored reference subtraction or polynomial voltage background is used in the fit.

center_mhz.source: Visible doublet location; numerical interval, not a field measurement

split_mhz.source: Initial feature spacing; fitted reduced-frequency scale

eta.source: Fitted single-site EFG asymmetry; no empirical horn corrections

P_model.source: Spin-temperature branch-ratio fit; stored acquisition pol and cc are not used

log10_signal_scale_cgs.source: Effective fitted ND3 susceptibility scale; numerical interval, no DAQ or coupling calibration

log10_tune_capacitance_pf.source: Fitted series capacitor; initialized at the nominal tutorial resonance, not a measured knob setting

phase_slope_rad_per_mhz.source: Fitted slow detector phase; explicit search interval in rad/MHz

phase_curvature_rad_per_mhz2.source: Fitted slow detector phase; explicit search interval in rad/MHz squared

limitations: Circuit constants are explicit tutorial assumptions; actual ND3 cable, coil, losses and detector calibration remain unresolved
Capacitance, detector phase, readout and ND3 shape are fitted jointly; fit estimates are not independent measurements
All five records are development examples from one acquisition period, not independent held-out experiments
Interpolation correlates errors; raw-fit residuals do not establish measured noise covariance or calibrated parameter uncertainty
config.sampling: Same float64 linear interpolation as examples/uva-nd3.json; the reader keeps the original measurements in its internal tools/_data/ resource.

nominal_circuit.status: tutorial assumptions; not measured ND3 hardware
nominal_circuit.source: Standalone circuit.py nominal_circuit: supplied tutorial component seeds and a derived half-wave operating point at 32.68 MHz. This is a declared conditional scenario, not the measured butanol cable setup or an ND3 calibration.
